stable.notes: Node symbols name their parts; splices read like one-cavity connectors (flat S-numbers); Auto Fix in the node dialog; Function renames move the wire with the new default wire; node table sizes; short design rule messages with error / warning totals.

beta.notes: The wire's far end as a Cascade: Node, then Connector, then Cavity. The Remote Connector cell is editable and lists the node's connectors (C-number, part number, device) and splices; the Function fill asks which connector when two devices on one node carry it; a splice-only node lands on its splice at once; splices carry a label; junctions leave the Node dropdown. A typed Remote Cavity is saved; status, remote function and wire length follow an edit.
